evaluations.evidence: search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: searching/discovering music using content identification (different methods are alternatives/attributes of the same feature).

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: personalized search/discovery driven by user profile.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: collaborative-filtering style discovery based on similar users.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music or ringback tones similar to a given music video based on content similarity
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: content-similarity based discovery (different target item types are variants of the same feature).

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music by exploiting enriched metadata and image tags
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: metadata-driven search/discovery; enumerated goals are outcomes of that feature, not independent features.

evaluations.evidence: upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps
evaluations.rationale: Combines two independently implementable features: uploading tagged videos and ensuring tags are propagated/available to downstream processing.

evaluations.evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: presenting thumbnail sequences for segments.

evaluations.evidence: get info about similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: retrieving information about similar video content (items and segments are related aspects of the same feature).

evaluations.evidence: get info about perceptually similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: information about perceptually similar content; items/segments are variants of the same requirement.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations from similar profiles
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: recommendation generation based on similar profiles.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: context-aware recommendations based on local news events.

evaluations.evidence: identify persons in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Two separable features: person identification and retrieval/delivery of related information (can be implemented/tested independently).

evaluations.evidence: identify products in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Combines product detection/identification and fetching/displaying related product information—independently implementable features.

evaluations.evidence: identify broadcaster logos in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Separate features: logo detection and retrieval/presentation of related metadata are independently testable/implementable.

evaluations.evidence: identify brands in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Brand identification and providing related information are distinct features that can be prioritized and implemented separately.

evaluations.evidence: take a picture or upload an image, so that I am recommended with videos related to that picture or image
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: image-based recommendation; 'take or upload' are alternative input methods, not multiple features.

evaluations.evidence: walk around, access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area
evaluations.rationale: Single geospatial discovery feature: mobile/geolocation-based content discovery; listed behaviors are part of one cohesive feature.

evaluations.evidence: search content items using automatic speech recognition
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: ASR-powered content search.

evaluations.evidence: see, validate and edit segmentation of videos
evaluations.rationale: Combines multiple distinct actions (viewing, validating, editing) that are independently implementable and testable.

evaluations.evidence: annotate news video segments and extract a topic for each segment
evaluations.rationale: Two separable features: manual annotation and automatic topic-extraction; each can be implemented and tested separately.

evaluations.evidence: filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects
evaluations.rationale: Filtering and ranking are closely related steps of a single quality-based curation feature rather than separate independent features.

evaluations.evidence: get a quick assessment of whether audio material has been edited before the upload
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: automated quick assessment for pre-upload audio editing detection.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter nudity content
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: automated nudity prefiltering.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter content using search based on low­level asset information
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: prefiltering via low-level asset-based search.

evaluations.evidence: automatically validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: automated copyright validation of ingested content.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter the content using search on high­level asset information such as metadata and tags
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: prefiltering using high-level metadata/tags.

evaluations.evidence: assess how interesting or appealing or complex a picture is based on automated analysis, citizen annotations, and comments on Talk
evaluations.rationale: Single assessment feature that aggregates multiple inputs; enumerated inputs are part of the same feature, not separate features.

evaluations.evidence: detect when a scientist should be prompted to look at a subject, based on annotations and information from Talk comments
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: detection/prompting decision rule using annotations and comments as inputs.

evaluations.evidence: identify volunteer types
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: volunteer type identification/classification.

evaluations.evidence: preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images using simple low­level image features
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: automated preclassification using low-level features.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Snapshot Serengeti images with no classifiable animals in them
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: empty/no-animal image detection.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic image series detection for the case of timestamping malfunction
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: detect image series caused by timestamp malfunction.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: species preclassification.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal attribute preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: attribute preclassification (e.g., behaviors, attributes).

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal number detection in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: counting animals in images.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic segmentation or localization of plankton
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: segmentation/localization of plankton (alternatives of same capability), not multiple independent features.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton in them
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: detect images without classifiable plankton.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic detection of plankton size or orientation in Plankton Portal images
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: measure plankton size/orientation (attributes of the same detection feature).

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic preclassification of plankton species in Plankton Portal images
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: species preclassification.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic worm motion analysis to reduce video duration in Worm Watch Lab
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: motion analysis for video trimming/compaction.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect the time in a Worm Watch Lab video where the worm lays an egg
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: event detection (egg-laying time) in video.

evaluations.evidence: detect important features such as areas of flooding, damage, temporary shelters, blocked roads etc in the satellite images
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: detecting important disaster-related features (enumeration are examples of the same detection capability).

evaluations.evidence: assess the probability/weight of a volunteer’s classification based on their experience
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: weighting/classification confidence estimation based on volunteer experience.

evaluations.evidence: perform prefiltering of the images to remove artefacts such as bright stars and camera read errors
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: artefact prefiltering for images.

evaluations.evidence: detect moving and transient objects in the images
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: motion/transient object detection.

evaluations.evidence: remove background noise and distracting sounds from the audio files
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: audio denoising/removal of distracting sounds.

evaluations.evidence: group whale calls that are similar
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: clustering/grouping similar whale calls.

evaluations.evidence: identify the number of whales heard in a single audio file
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: counting whales from audio.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should interrupt a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: interruption timing decision.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: selecting interruption modality (enumerated modalities are options within one decision feature).

evaluations.evidence: know when I should educate a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: timing decision for educational interventions.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: selecting education modality; modalities are alternatives within the same feature.

evaluations.evidence: know which piece of education I should give to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: selecting the educational content to present.

evaluations.evidence: know when a volunteer has made an interesting comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: detecting interesting comments.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: trigger/timing decision for Zoonibot commenting.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should give an explanation
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: deciding when to provide an explanation via Zoonibot.

evaluations.evidence: know what Zoonibot should say to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: selecting Zoonibot's message content.

evaluations.evidence: group subjects by similarity
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: subject grouping/clustering by similarity.

evaluations.evidence: recommend different projects to volunteers based on their previous experiences
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: project recommendation based on volunteer history.

evaluations.evidence: see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: article summarization for reuse.
